summary: Product-scoped record for BingX Earn and its BingX Wealth predecessor. BingX officially launched Wealth on 21 August 2023 with flexible-term and fixed-term products; current first-party surfaces use the Earn name while retaining the same product family.
what_happened: BingX officially launched BingX Wealth on 21 August 2023 with flexible-term and fixed-term yield products. It later added Wealth as Margin, allowing subscribed USDT Wealth assets to be used as perpetual-futures margin while continuing to accrue interest unless liquidated. Current BingX product surfaces use the Earn label. Those surfaces market Earn as principal protected / profits guaranteed while also carrying a broad risk warning that digital-asset and derivatives activity can result in partial or total loss of account funds. CYA preserves both statements as attributed company language and does not convert the marketing claim into a universal legal, custody or solvency guarantee.
uncertainty_notes: The 21 August 2023 date is the verified BingX Wealth launch date. The reviewed sources establish continuity into the current BingX Earn product family but do not establish the exact formal Wealth-to-Earn rename date, so no rename date is invented.
notes: The broader BingX exchange, Loan, Dual Investment and derivatives products are outside this product identity. Wealth-as-margin liquidation risk is recorded separately from ordinary flexible/fixed Earn redemption mechanics.

summary: Product-scoped record for MEXC Flexible Savings and Fixed Savings. Current first-party materials in 2026 document active Savings products, variable non-guaranteed APR, flexible and fixed redemption rules, and explicit principal-loss and asset-use risks. An original Savings launch date is not inferred.
what_happened: MEXC continues to operate Flexible Savings and Fixed Savings within MEXC Earn. A January 2026 product update moved Flexible Savings interest calculation to an hourly basis effective 4 February 2026, and February 2026 materials document use of Flexible Savings assets as a funding source for futures positions. The March 2026 MEXC Earn Service Agreement states that Earn is not principal-protected, users can lose principal in whole or in part, MEXC may combine users' digital assets, and users authorize MEXC to deal with subscribed assets as it deems fit to generate returns. The same agreement states that APR can change and is not guaranteed. CYA excludes On-Chain Earn from this product identity.
uncertainty_notes: The reviewed sources confirm active Flexible and Fixed Savings in 2026 but do not establish the original Savings launch date, so launch_date remains null. Product availability, supported assets, rates, lockups and jurisdiction eligibility change over time.
notes: On-Chain Earn, Futures Earn, Hold and Earn and other MEXC Earn families are outside this product identity unless separately reviewed.
